_: Colour worlds: grounds are bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-overlay, line, line-strong, skeleton (dark theme). scripts/worlds.mjs turns this into src/app/worlds.css.

lobby.note: Home: the Projection Booth lobby. Cinematic black and charcoal, warm amber light, burgundy atmosphere.

observatory.note: Discover: the Mood Observatory. Deep navy, restrained cyan.

casting.note: Match: the Casting Table. Wine grounds, rose accent.

studio.note: Reel Director: the Director’s Studio. Obsidian and muted gold.

screening.note: Clips: the Screening Room. True black, restrained violet.

records.note: Collections: the Record Store. Forest green and brass.

greenroom.note: Profile: the Green Room. Midnight blue and silver; a personal accent replaces silver.

premiere.note: Film details: the Premiere. The accent is re-derived from each poster at runtime.

afterparty.note: Post-Credits Club: the Afterparty. Plum and lavender.

gallery.note: Wall of Fame: the gallery after hours. Warm plaster dark, brass light.

planetarium.note: SceneAtlas: the cinematic planetarium. Graphite night, electric blue and muted violet light.
